input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation or most-favoured-customer obligation on us. Section 12.3 expressly confirms that we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment and preserves our freedom to deal with other suppliers, and searches for MFN-type language ("most favoured", "no less favourable", "best", third-party matching) returned nothing else. The fee provisions (§ 7.1 fixed Fees with no undisclosed charges; § 8.3 capped renewal uplift) run in our favour and create no hidden obligation to extend better third-party terms to Vendor. This meets the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer), so no redline is proposed.
